text: きずなばしは　しずかに　わたろう！

structure.jp: しずかに　わたろう！

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: Changing the verb's ending to おう means 'let's do it'. わたろう = 'let's cross'.

patterns.name: 〜に (how)
patterns.explanation: に after a describing word like しずか turns it into the way something is done. しずかに = 'quietly'.
